questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates the candidate's ability to design end-to-end tenant onboarding, isolation, governance, and observability in Azure DevOps at production scale.

## Key Concepts
- Parameterized YAML templates and conditional deployment
- Per-tenant resource isolation: Resource Group, App Service plan, deployment slot
- App Configuration and Key Vault integration
- Database seeding and tenant-specific tests in isolated environments
- Policy gates and drift detection
- Rollback strategy and per-tenant auditing to Azure Monitor

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger: none

parameters:
  - name: tenantId
    type: string
    displayName: 'Tenant ID'
  - name: tenantDomain
    type: string
    displayName: 'Tenant Domain'

variables:
  azureServiceConnection: 'azure-spn'
  subscriptionId: '$(AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID)'
  resourceGroupName: 'rg-$(tenantId)'
  appServicePlanName: 'asp-$(tenantId)'
  appServiceName: 'api-$(tenantId)'
  appConfigName: 'appconfig-$(tenantId)'
  keyVaultName: 'kv-shared-01'
  databaseServerName: 'sql-$(tenantId)'
  databaseName: 'db-$(tenantId)'

stages:
  - stage: Provision
    displayName: 'Provision Tenant Resources'
    jobs:
      - job: ProvisionResources
        displayName: 'Provision Infrastructure'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create Resource Group'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az group create --name $(resourceGroupName) --location eastus
                az configure --defaults group=$(resourceGroupName)

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create App Service Plan'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az appservice plan create --name $(appServicePlanName) --sku S1 --is-linux

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create App Service with Deployment Slot'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az webapp create --name $(appServiceName) --plan $(appServicePlanName) --runtime 'NODE|18-lts'
                az webapp deployment slot create --name $(appServiceName) --slot staging

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create SQL Database'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az sql server create --name $(databaseServerName) --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --location eastus
                az sql db create --name $(databaseName) --server $(databaseServerName) --service-tier Basic

  - stage: Configure
    displayName: 'Configure Tenant'
    dependsOn: Provision
    jobs:
      - job: LoadConfiguration
        displayName: 'Load Settings and Secrets'
        steps:
          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            displayName: 'Fetch Tenant Secrets'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
              SecretsFilter: '*'
              RunAsPreJob: false

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Configure App Settings'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az webapp config appsettings set --name $(appServiceName) --slot staging --settings \
                  TENANT_ID=$(tenantId) \
                  TENANT_DOMAIN=$(tenantDomain) \
                  DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRING='Server=tcp:$(databaseServerName).database.windows.net,1433;Database=$(databaseName);User ID=$(keyVaultTenantUser);Password=$(keyVaultTenantPassword);Encrypt=true;'

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Seed Database'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                sqlcmd -S $(databaseServerName).database.windows.net -d $(databaseName) -U $(keyVaultTenantUser) -P $(keyVaultTenantPassword) -i seed-tenant.sql

  - stage: Deploy
    displayName: 'Deploy to Staging'
    dependsOn: Configure
    jobs:
      - job: DeployApplication
        displayName: 'Deploy to Staging Slot'
        steps:
          - task: AzureWebApp@1
            displayName: 'Deploy to Staging Slot'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              appType: 'webApp'
              appName: $(appServiceName)
              deployToSlotOrASE: true
              resourceGroupName: $(resourceGroupName)
              slotName: 'staging'

  - stage: Test
    displayName: 'Run Tests'
    dependsOn: Deploy
    jobs:
      - job: RunTests
        displayName: 'Execute Tenant Tests'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Run Unit Tests'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                npm test -- --tenantId=$(tenantId) --environment=staging

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Run Integration Tests'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                npm run test:integration -- --tenantId=$(tenantId) --environment=staging

  - stage: GateAndPolicy
    displayName: 'Policy Gates & Drift Check'
    dependsOn: Test
    jobs:
      - job: PolicyCheck
        displayName: 'Verify Policy Compliance'
        steps:
          - task: AzurePolicy@0
            displayName: 'Check Azure Policy Compliance'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              resourceGroupName: $(resourceGroupName)
              definitionId: '/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policyDefinitions/...' 

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Drift Detection'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az deployment group show --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --name initial-deployment
                # Compare current state with desired state

  - stage: Promote
    displayName: 'Promote to Production'
    dependsOn: GateAndPolicy
    condition: succeeded()
    jobs:
      - job: SwapSlots
        displayName: 'Swap Staging to Production'
        steps:
          - task: AzureAppServiceManage@0
            displayName: 'Swap Staging to Production'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              Action: 'Swap Slots'
              WebAppName: $(appServiceName)
              ResourceGroupName: $(resourceGroupName)
              SourceSlot: 'staging'

  - stage: Audit
    displayName: 'Audit & Logging'
    dependsOn: Promote
    jobs:
      - job: LogAuditTrail
        displayName: 'Send Audit Logs to Azure Monitor'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Log Tenant Onboarding'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor app-insights trace show \
                  --location eastus \
                  --query "[?operationName == 'tenant-onboarding']"

                # Send custom event
                az monitor app-insights events show --app $(appInsightsName) --type customEvents
```

This YAML pipeline demonstrates a complete tenant onboarding workflow with infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, testing, policy enforcement, and production deployment with full audit logging capabilities.

## Why This Is Asked
This evaluates foundational CI/CD knowledge including pipeline configuration, artifact management, and release governance with security controls.

## Key Concepts
- Azure Pipelines YAML configuration and triggers
- Python environment setup with version 3.11
- Test execution with pytest and coverage reporting
- Wheel package building and artifact publishing
- Release environments with manual approval gates
- Security scanning integration for production deployments

## Code Example
```yaml
# Azure Pipelines YAML for Python CI/CD
trigger:
  - main
pr:
  - main

pool:
  vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'

variables:
  pythonVersion: '3.11'

stages:
- stage: Build
  displayName: 'Build and Test Stage'
  jobs:
  - job: BuildJob
    displayName: 'Build and Test'
    steps:
    - task: UsePythonVersion@0
      inputs:
        versionSpec: '$(pythonVersion)'
      displayName: 'Use Python $(pythonVersion)'
    
    - script: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install pytest pytest-cov
      displayName: 'Install dependencies'
    
    - script: |
        pytest --cov=. --cov-report=xml --cov-report=html
      displayName: 'Run tests with coverage'
    
    - script: |
        python setup.py bdist_wheel
      displayName: 'Build wheel package'
    
    - task: PublishBuildArtifacts@1
      inputs:
        pathToPublish: 'dist'
        artifactName: 'python-wheel'
      displayName: 'Publish wheel artifact'

- stage: Release
  displayName: 'Release to Production'
  dependsOn: Build
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - deployment: DeployToProd
    displayName: 'Deploy to Production'
    environment: 'Production'
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - task: DownloadBuildArtifacts@0
            inputs:
              buildType: 'current'
              downloadType: 'single'
              artifactName: 'python-wheel'
              downloadPath: '$(System.ArtifactsDirectory)'
          
          - task: AntiMalware@3
            inputs:
              InputType: 'Basic'
              ScanDirectory: '$(System.ArtifactsDirectory)/python-wheel'
            displayName: 'Security scan'
          
          - script: |
              echo 'Deploying to production...'
            displayName: 'Deploy to production'
```

## Implementation Notes
- The pipeline triggers on both push and PR to main branch
- Uses Python 3.11 with proper dependency management
- Includes comprehensive testing with pytest and coverage reporting
- Builds and publishes wheel package as build artifact
- Production deployment requires manual approval through environment
- Built-in security scanning (AntiMalware) before production promotion
- Follows Azure DevOps best practices for stage-based deployment

This evaluates expertise in designing production-grade, GitOps-driven CI/CD pipelines that create isolated, ephemeral environments for pull requests while maintaining security, compliance, and cost efficiency.

## Key Concepts
- Selective builds based on path detection in monorepos
- PR-scoped container tagging and Azure Container Registry integration
- Managed identity authentication with Azure Key Vault
- Policy enforcement through Kyverno validation gates
- Ephemeral environments with automatic cleanup and TTL management
- GitOps reconciliation and drift prevention using FluxCD
- End-to-end testing with isolated staging databases
- Comprehensive observability via Azure Monitor with cost controls

## Code Example
```yaml
# azure-pipelines.yml - PR-driven ephemeral deployment pipeline
trigger:
  none
pr:
  branches:
    include:
    - main

variables:
  - group: azure-infrastructure
  - name: prNumber
    value: $(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber)
  - name: prTag
    value: 'pr-$(prNumber)'

stages:
- stage: DetectChanges
  displayName: 'Detect Changed Services'
  jobs:
  - job: detect
    steps:
    - bash: |
        git diff origin/main --name-only > changed_files.txt
        echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=changedServices;isOutput=true]$(python detect-services.py changed_files.txt)"
      name: detect

- stage: BuildAndPush
  displayName: 'Build and Push Services'
  dependsOn: DetectChanges
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - job: build
    strategy:
      matrix: $[ stageDependencies.DetectChanges.detect.outputs['detect.changedServices'] ]
    steps:
    - task: Docker@2
      inputs:
        containerRegistry: $(acrServiceConnection)
        repository: $(service.name)
        tags: |
          $(prTag)
          $(Build.BuildNumber)
        command: buildAndPush
        Dockerfile: $(service.path)/Dockerfile
```
